contact.strip.partner.body: We grow with you, not for you.
contact.dev.title: Building the future with us?
contact.dev.body: Developers and engineers who want to contribute to the IO SKY ecosystem.
eng.intro: IO SKY Engineering Access is an invitation-only programme for senior engineers, architects and AI specialists who want to contribute to a real operational intelligence platform under NDA. Every application is reviewed manually by our engineering operations team.
eng.what.title: What we look for
eng.what.1: Senior engineering judgment — five years or more building production systems.
eng.what.2: Operational thinking — comfortable with infrastructure, automation and data flow, not just UI.
eng.what.3: Discretion — willingness to operate inside NDA-protected environments and respect client data.
eng.what.4: Craft — taste for premium product surfaces, measured motion and disciplined design language.
eng.process.title: Process
eng.process.2: Engineering ops reviews and signs NDA
